decided: No payment and no paid package. Every screen and document is free and nothing shows a price. The owner's 유료화 구조 (a free 3-minute check, then a 9,900-19,900원 package) is not built: the case found that charging to write Employment Insurance Act papers for someone's own case is work 공인노무사법 제2조①2호 and 제27조① give only to 노무사. The owner was not asked; they can change this at the drawing.

The '고용센터 제출용 의견서 초안' the request names is given as a fill-in frame (DC-05 퇴직 경위 진술서). Name, dates, the chosen 호 and its 조문, and the evidence list come from the person's answers. The five narrative boxes are written in the person's own words, with question prompts only. No model writes sentences, and no model key is needed.
It says 가능성, never 판정. Only three phrases are used: 요건에 맞아 보여요 / 더 확인이 필요해요 / 요건에 못 미쳐요. Every answer shows its 조문, and every screen says 판정은 고용센터가 해요.

No 노무사 제휴 (partnership). The 'get a person' route (HP-01) is free public channels only: 1350, ai.moel.go.kr, 서울노동권익센터 1661-2020, 청소년·청년근로권익센터 1644-3119, 경기 스마트 마을노무사, plus 한국공인노무사회's 공인노무사 찾기 with the line that the product takes no money from 노무사. A paid referral to a specific 노무사 is barred by 공인노무사법 제27조의2.

No account and no sign-in. Everything a person enters, including health, family, harassment and union details, stays in that phone's browser and is wiped with one press (PV-01). Nothing goes to a server, so there is no separate sensitive-data consent screen.
주민등록번호 is never asked. The 발급요청서 (별지 제75호의3서식) uses 생년월일 only. The 근로복지공단 피보험자격확인 청구서 (별지 제20호서식) needs 주민등록번호, so the product does not fill it: NX-01 says where to file it and links the form.
Form: phone-size web with four tabs (점검, 서류, 기준, 묻기). The check flow CK-01 to RS-01 is five steps with no tab bar, at most three questions per 호, and 약 3분 is shown on the first screen.
Feel (the owner said nothing about it): calm and not alarming, exact like an official document, 해요체. Red is only for deadlines and for the warning that writing untrue facts is 부정수급 (고용보험법 제116조).

Numeric rules, each with its source: (1) 임금체불 follows a 고용노동부 빠른인터넷상담 answer. Unpaid and late periods add up to 60 days or more, 3할 or more unpaid for 2 consecutive months, or under 3할 for 6 consecutive months. (2) 최저임금: 2025년 10,030원, 2026년 10,320원, 2027년 10,700원. (3) 1호 라목 and 3의2호 lean to '더 확인이 필요해요' when the workplace has fewer than 5 people or the person does not know. (4) The 180일 기본 요건 is estimated as calendar days × 6/7 for a 5-day week, with a line saying the exact number is in 고용24.

Evidence lists: 고용노동부 has no public one-page list of evidence per reason (searched moel.go.kr, ei.go.kr, work24.go.kr, korea.kr). Each item says where it comes from: named in the law or a form, a 고용노동부 answer, or commonly submitted. Each list adds '고용센터가 다른 자료를 더 물을 수 있어요'.
The 정정 요청서 (DC-06) is a letter frame, because no statutory form exists for it. It uses fixed template sentences with blanks and one free box of 600 characters in the person's own words.
Limits: name 20 characters, workplace name 40, address 80. The 진술서 has five boxes of 800 characters each. All 19 reasons can be chosen. Amounts 0-99,999,999원, commute 0-600 minutes, care days 0-365.
